g.text: Adds student to the docker and clab_admins groups, makes the trusted lab folders group-writable and
sets the containerlab SUID bit, which VS Code Remote-SSH with the Containerlab extension needs. Lab
operations must already be enabled (Install/update does it).
The manager and its data. Nothing is rebuilt.
New groups apply to new logins: reconnect SSH, and in VS Code run "Remote-SSH: Kill VS Code Server
on Host..." before using the extension.
Docker, Compose, containerlab, Git and SSH found
Account and helpers present; password state needs sudo
docker and clab_admins groups and containerlab access for student
